from more_itertools import seekable
from itertools import count

it = seekable((str(n) for n in count()))

print(f'next(it): {next(it)}')  # '1'
print(f'next(it): {next(it)}')  # '2'
it.relative_seek(1)
print(f'after relative_seek(1), next(it): {next(it)}')  # Should be '4'
it.relative_seek(-2)
print(f'after relative_seek(-2), next(it): {next(it)}')  # Should be '2'
print('SUCCESS!')
" 2>&1
